title: HV_Harness: a human-AI workflow for synteny-grounded gene-family curation in allotetraploid carp genomes
description:
A structured human–AI collaboration protocol — a curation playbook plus supporting generic scripts — for building a synteny-grounded inventory and interactive hierarchy explorer of any gene group across the cyprinid Cs4R allotetraploid genomes (common carp Cyprinus carpio, Prussian carp Carassius gibelio, goldfish Carassius auratus), using zebrafish (Danio rerio) as a diploid comparator and publicly available NCBI-style annotation files only.

The AI agent performs mechanical operations (GFF parsing, sequence extraction, flanking-gene retrieval, rendering) while the human curator supplies domain judgement at five explicit checkpoints. Gene identity is assigned on conserved syntenic position rather than similarity-based naming, with the original annotation preserved throughout. All inferences are annotation-level.

Ships two worked examples: the caspase gene family curated independently in all three focal carp species, and a smaller granulin example in common carp.
